name: How to Change the Course of History?
source:
This mod tells the story of how one of the fans of this game, which well could not put up with obviously not very good endings in it, somehow magically manages to find himself inside it. In consequence he decides to save all the girls and prevent all the sad events, in which he will be helped by Monika herself, having realized all her mistakes.

Based on the Russian fanfic "How to Change the Course of History?" by YoungXenon91.

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/wjol3v/hcch_full_release/]Reddit[/url]]
